'''VX-391''' was a freighter that carried the bodies of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].

==History==
[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] piloted the ship by enslaving a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] as all biological lifeforms that were scanned on the ship would be irradiated and vaporized. After the freighter passed inspection, [[Juhm]] questioned the operators of the irradiator why there was one extra ship in the convoy. As the freighter entered the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Gwori]], the convoy was ordered to change course, and Artoo could not adjust, thus pointing out the impostor. Artoo ejected the carbonite blocks and itself into the sands below just before the ship was destroyed by droid fighters.
